北湾跨 Marin、Sonoma 与 Napa 三县，招生由具体学区办理，没有统: The North Bay spans Marin, Sonoma, and Napa counties. Individual districts handle enrollment; there is no single North Bay application. Start with the county, then use the actual address, grade, and school year. Neither the city name nor the nearest school determines assignment. County education directories help locate the right district, which confirms placement.
Marin：官方学区页有地址或地块边界查询，并分列初等、高中和统一学区。小学与高: Marin: the official district page provides address or parcel boundary lookup and lists elementary, high-school, and unified districts separately. Elementary and high-school districts may differ; save both results and consult the directory for the intended grade.
Sonoma：从 SCOE Directory 进入 District Look: Sonoma: enter District Lookup from the SCOE directory, then confirm school attendance boundaries with the district. District boundaries and individual school attendance areas are separate checks; a county map alone does not establish a campus assignment.
Napa：NCOE 目录列有 NVUSD、St. Helena、Calistog: Napa: the NCOE directory lists NVUSD, St. Helena, Calistoga, and other districts; NVUSD does not cover the entire county. If the address belongs to NVUSD, follow its registration page to School of Residence. When the interactive map carries an update notice, confirm the result with the district.
先问当前学年，再准备注册与支持: Confirm the school year before arranging enrollment and support
确认负责学区后，问现在入学还是下一学年申请，领取对应材料清单、提交入口和审核联系: After identifying the district, clarify whether this is current-year enrollment or a next-year application, then obtain the correct document checklist, submission channel, and review contact. Old dates or system-maintenance notices do not establish that enrollment is unavailable. If Napa page sections refer to different years, confirm with the registration office before using an old window. Intradistrict and interdistrict transfers have separate processes; Sonoma guidance makes clear that acceptance is not automatic, so follow both sending and receiving decisions.
新到家庭可询问语言评估、翻译、辅导员及家校沟通工具；已有学习支持计划时问记录如何: New families can ask about language assessment, interpretation, counselors, and family communication tools. For an existing learning-support plan, ask how records can be transferred securely. Arrange school visits through the official directory and office, and check pickup procedures, after-school eligibility and fees, and whether transportation serves the address. A neighbor’s arrangements are not a countywide standard.
